lines.speaker: Surveyor Dave
lines.text: Oh! I didn't see you there. Who are you?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Hello... I'm the newly appointed surveyor for Fetteresso Estate. Were you not expecting me? I'm here to select an assistant.

lines.speaker: Surveyor Dave
lines.text: Oh! Of course, of course... What do you need?

options.text: I'm here to find out more about you!
Now that I think about it, I should probably be on my way.
